Cycle area. Repeatedly play or record over the project section within the yellow bar. Drag the bar to move the range, or the edges to edit the length.
Playhead. Indicates the playback position. Move by dragging, clicking the lower part of the ruler, or using the LCD Position displays.
Project Start marker. Indicates the project start point. Drag left to play upbeats or program change commands before the first downbeat.
Project End marker. Indicates the project end point. When recording, the marker moves to fit the project length. Drag vertically to change position.
